serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I will try contacting Little Richard, maybe he could help me.
AbusedTenant: Hello. Richard, I might have a problem
Little_Richard: Hello, what do you mean?
AbusedTenant: Someone called me and wanted me to go on a mission.
Little_Richard: What? That’s not possible.
AbusedTenant: It's the truth!
Little_Richard: Listen, I talked with the Admin and he told me no mission takes place over the phone.
AbusedTenant: What? Then who I was talking to?
Little_Richard: No idea. 
AbusedTenant: What am I supposed to do?
Little_Richard: I will talk with Admin again if that’s what you want.
AbusedTenant: Please do.
What the hell is going on? All this matter seems fishy. Who’s orders did I execute? Admin’s or perhaps someone else?
This all seems very suspicious to me. Now I need to wait to find out if my decision to confront the caller was a good idea or not.
